10000301.name: Dreamy Sunglow
10000301.description: A curious magical material. At first glance, it radiates with the warmth of a fresh sunrise, but the longer you hold its gaze, the more the light softens into a drifting, dreamlike haze.
10000301.comment:
Chance to obtain through Elemental Altars
Daily Limit: 1,000.

10000301.description: 不思議な性質を持つ魔法素材。朝焼けのような光を放つが、凝視すると深い霧に包まれたような錯覚に陥る。

10000301.name: 몽환의 노을빛
10000301.description: 신비로운 마법 재료. 언뜻 보면 아침노을처럼 화려하지만, 계속 바라보고 있으면 안개 낀 심연 같은 묘한 몽환감에 빠져들게 된다.
10000301.comment:
